title: Redpanda metrics dataset
description: One release's metric families, written by doc-tools generate metrics-docs as redpanda-metrics-<version>.json.

generated_from.description: What the dataset was built from.

sources.description: Number of brokers or files scraped per endpoint.

source_ref.description: Git ref of the source inventory, when one was used.

removed.description: Metric family name -> a family an earlier release had and this one does not.

introduced.description: Release the family first appeared in.

removed.description: Release the family was removed in.

excluded.description: Families the source defines that are left out on purpose, each with a reason.

provenance.description: scraped: read from a running broker. source: read from the Redpanda source. derived: computed from another field. override: from the overrides file. curated: an entry that exists only in the overrides file. requirements: from the metric requirements file.

observed_values.description: Values seen in the scrape, when there are few enough to be a set a reader can learn. Not a complete list.

description.description: Text for readers. From the overrides file.

values.description: The complete set of values the label can take. From the overrides file.

availability.description: Deployment -> whether the metric is available there.

requirement.description: One thing the cluster needs before it exports the family: a property value, or a state described in a sentence.

value.description: The value the property must have.

condition.description: A state the cluster must be in, as one plain sentence.

evidence.description: measured: the family was absent without this and present with it on a real cluster. source: read from the Redpanda source, not measured.

buckets.description: Upper bounds of the buckets, as the le label prints them, ascending, +Inf last.

series.description: Suffixes of the series the family exposes.

source_description.description: The HELP text exactly as Redpanda defines it.

observed.description: false when the family comes from the source inventory and was not in the scrape.

defined_in.description: Source file that registers the family.

description_cloud_only.description: Extra description paragraphs for Cloud docs only. From the overrides file.

description_self_managed_only.description: Extra description paragraphs for Self-Managed docs only. From the overrides file.

use_cases.description: What a reader uses the metric for.

usage.description: How to use the metric, as AsciiDoc.

requires.description: When the family is exported: the property values it needs, or text.

introduced.description: Release the family first appeared in.

deprecated.description: Release the family was deprecated in, or a note. null when it is not deprecated.

related_topics.description: Xrefs to related pages, in the same form as the property overrides.

provenance.description: Field name -> where its value came from.
